parameters.query: INSERT INTO gov.timeline_dev (mission_id, run_id, executor_id, performed_by, occurred_at, phase, duration_ref, milestone, prompt_executor, quality_gate, context_summary, context_payload, udn_line, artifact_ref, event_hash, source) VALUES ('{{$json.mission_id_sql}}', NULLIF('{{$json.run_id_sql}}',''), '{{$json.executor_id_sql}}', '{{$json.performed_by_sql}}', '{{$json.occurred_at_sql}}'::timestamptz, '{{$json.phase_sql}}', '{{$json.duration_ref_sql}}', '{{$json.milestone_sql}}', '{{$json.prompt_executor_sql}}', '{{$json.quality_gate_sql}}', NULLIF('{{$json.context_summary_sql}}',''), '{{$json.context_payload_sql}}'::jsonb, '{{$json.udn_line_sql}}', NULLIF('{{$json.artifact_ref_sql}}',''), '{{$json.event_hash_sql}}', '{{$json.source_sql}}') ON CONFLICT (event_hash) DO NOTHING RETURNING timeline_id::text, mission_id, event_hash, to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at_utc;

INSERT INTO gov.timeline_evl (mission_id, run_id, executor_id, performed_by, occurred_at, timeline_ref, event_name, staff_action, context_summary, context_payload, artifact_ref, udn_line, event_hash, source) VALUES ('{{$json.mission_id_sql}}', NULLIF('{{$json.run_id_sql}}',''), '{{$json.executor_id_sql}}', '{{$json.performed_by_sql}}', '{{$json.occurred_at_sql}}'::timestamptz, '{{$json.timeline_ref_sql}}', '{{$json.event_name_sql}}', '{{$json.staff_action_sql}}', NULLIF('{{$json.context_summary_sql}}',''), '{{$json.context_payload_sql}}'::jsonb, NULLIF('{{$json.artifact_ref_sql}}',''), '{{$json.udn_line_sql}}', '{{$json.event_hash_sql}}', '{{$json.source_sql}}') ON CONFLICT (event_hash) DO NOTHING RETURNING timeline_id::text, mission_id, event_hash, to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at_utc;
